items.title: Call to Order
notes:
Chair M. Harris called the meeting to order at 1:13PM

Regional Chair K. Redman made remarks regarding the retirement of Craig Dyer, Commissioner, Corporate Services and Chief FInancial Officer, acknowledging his wealth of experience and expressing gratitude for his dedicated service. She highlighted the impactful initiatives he spearheaded and the visionary investments that contributed to Council's success.

items.title: Motion to Reconvene into Open Session
Strategic Priority - Resilient and Future Ready Organization
COR-CFN-24-008, Q1 2024 Plan and Financial Update
notes: Mathieu Goetzke, Acting Chief Administrative Officer, delivered a comprehensive update, detailing the community's progress and key highlights. These encompassed advancements in affordable housing, climate-aligned growth with a focus on expanding transit services, initiatives related to truth and reconciliation, and efforts to enhance mental health services. He elaborated on the latest developments concerning each strategic priority, while also sharing updates on recent funding announcements from both Provincial and Federal sources.

items.title: Motion Deferred from April 24, 2024
notes:
R. Deutschmann addressed his correspondence, suggesting that the Committee proceed with passing this motion to avoid any delays. He touched upon concerns regarding what he perceived as inappropriate remarks in the police board's letter, while also expressing appreciation to the Waterloo Regional Police Services board for their submitted responses.

D. Craig shared insights on the potential political ramifications stemming from these inquiries directed at the police board.

items.title: Next Meeting - June 4, 2024
notes:
C. Dyer shared sentiments regarding his upcoming retirement, expressing gratitude for the privilege of serving as the CFO at the Region for the past 12 years. He expressed appreciation for the opportunity to collaborate with a dedicated team of staff.

S. Foxton enquired about the possibility of rescinding the election sign bylaw and requested staff to investigate further.

N. Salonen made a request for staff to provide information on honorariums.
